title: FootFlex Product Warranty Policy & FAQs
content: FootFlex provides a 30-day manufacturer warranty covering genuine manufacturing defects on all footwear purchases. Defects covered include sole detachment, upper stitching tears under normal usage, structural heel breakdown, or defective zippers/hardware. Warranty claims must be submitted to support@footflex.com along with invoice copy and photos of the defect. Upon inspection, FootFlex will provide a free replacement or store credit. Damage resulting from normal wear and tear, chemical exposure, animal damage, improper washing, or deliberate misuse is excluded from warranty coverage.

faqs.question: Do FootFlex shoes come with a warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes! All FootFlex footwear carries a 30-day manufacturer warranty covering genuine manufacturing defects.

faqs.question: What is covered under the 30-day FootFlex warranty?
faqs.answer: Covered defects include sole detachment, stitching failures, broken hardware, or structural defects occurring during normal wear.

faqs.question: What is excluded from the warranty?
faqs.answer: Normal wear and tear, sole erosion from rough usage, accidental cuts, water/chemical damage, or improper washing are not covered.

faqs.question: How do I claim a warranty for a defective shoe?
faqs.answer: Email support@footflex.com with your Order ID, proof of purchase, and clear photographs of the defect for immediate evaluation.
